title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 3: Akemi Ooshima
native_title: プラドル ＤＩＳＣ Ｖｏｌ．３ ～大島朱美～
overview: Private Idol Disc Vol. 3: Ooshima Akemi is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Akemi Ooshima. It includes a gallery of photos and video clips of the idol, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors minigame. Winning three rounds of the minigame will unlock a bonus video.
